ground_truth_root_cause: The recommendation-service's upstream inference backend (openai-proxy) became entirely unreachable at ~07:35 UTC, causing all recommendation RPCs to time out after 5000ms. The openai-proxy connection pool was exhausted (50/50 active connections) before the proxy crashed, as evidenced by 'connection refused' errors in recommendation-service health checks starting at 07:35:17. The frontend circuit breaker correctly opened after 5 consecutive failures but the homepage recommendations section remained blank because openai-proxy never recovered. This is an infrastructure/dependency outage in the recommendation-service tier, not caused by any frontend code change; the most recent frontend-touching deploy (60d18e40e88c) was from 2026-04-23 and unrelated.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately: page the recommendation-service / ML-platform on-call team to investigate and restart the openai-proxy service. 2. Verify openai-proxy pod/container health in its namespace and check for OOM kills or crash loops using kubectl logs / describe. 3. Once openai-proxy is restored, manually reset the frontend circuit breaker for recommendation-service (or wait for the next successful half-open probe) to restore homepage recommendations. 4. As a short-term fallback, configure recommendation-service to serve cached or static fallback recommendations when openai-proxy is unavailable, so the frontend can display something rather than blank. All steps achievable within 2 hours assuming the openai-proxy process can be restarted or its resource limits corrected.
